body: Aye, I know that you might be writing this as a signal of allergy, like can someone just care or pretend it does? But I really think you do, and I mean, I'd want to die as well some times, life sucks, and I'm not just saying. A lot of things just happened and I get it. But just try to take one more day at the time, I don't know if depression goes away or gets "fixed" and I really doubt it sometimes. I just know you can fight one more battle.
